title: Grateful Dead Live at Seminole Indian Village on 1969-05-24
lineage: Cass > DAT >  DAT >  SONIC SOLUTIONS >  CD > CD > EAC [secure] > SHN

ai_review.summary: Pristine soundboard capture of an adventurous 5/24/69 show featuring smoking segues like China Cat → The Eleven and a standout Death Don't/Do‑in’ That Rag finale.
ai_review.review: The recording is a crystal‑clear soundboard source that lets the band’s 1969 wildness shine through. Highlights include an off‑the‑wall setlist with superb transitions – China Cat into The Eleven, Lovelight, Alligator → St. Stephen > Feedback and a heartfelt Death Don’t/Do‑in’ That Rag pairing. Reviewers praise Jerry’s enthusiastic guitar work and the Rhythm Devils’ power while noting only minor stream hiccups on The Eleven.

ai_rating.rationale: Over twenty reviews, almost all 4‑5 stars, uniformly praise both the musical performance and the pristine soundboard recording; only minor complaints about a few stream glitches.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Consistently described as crisp, pristine, hiss‑free and ‘primo’; no major dropouts noted aside from occasional streaming errors on The Eleven.

standout_songs: He Was A Friend Of Mine
show_quality.setlist_flow: An adventurous, off‑the‑wall setlist with daring segues (e.g., China Cat → The Eleven, Alligator → St. Stephen) that keep the momentum high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for enthusiastic, lyrical guitar work and overall energy (“Great Gar’s enthusiasm”).
band_member_comments.Drums: Rhythm Devils highlighted for a powerful conclusion; minor pause noted between Alligator drums out and St. Stephen.
